purpose: Canonical Continuum Mixed-Grid progressive H3 topology and defaults, with historical validation references retained separately.

placement.trajectory_capture: internal to H3ProgressiveMixedGridHandoff; no separate H3TrajectoryCapture node is required

canonical_defaults.weight_semantics: With guidance_mode=direction+temporal, acceleration_weight and consistency_weight are staged values only; apply_guidance does not use them unless the corresponding guidance mode is selected.

historical_direction_only_reference.evidence_scope: Matched difficult-motion square smoke retained as historical evidence; it is not the current node/workflow default.

historical_learned_transfer_ab.later_media_result: learned_3d was promoted after decoded-media testing showed artifact reduction for aggressive source-to-target handoffs; bicubic remains a compatibility control.

historical_faster_operating_points.note: valid/baseline-level reference; lower quality than the later 12/14 matched square runs
matched square run was perceptually better than 10; 46 logical / 32 actual / 14 forecast calls

auto_compute_handoff.media: different but no clear quality advantage over fixed 0.35

direction_plus_temporal.media: no perceptual difference from D14 direction-only
direction_plus_temporal.note: This historical result is retained as evidence and does not redefine the current requested default.

direction_plus_acceleration.media: corrected PECE implementation showed no clear quality improvement

invariants.continuum_grid: final target grid for the whole sequence
invariants.audio: caller audio noise/latent/mask preserved; no spatial transform
invariants.conditioning: target-grid conditioning is rebuilt after handoff
invariants.exact_probe: one explicit low-grid H3 probe per physical chunk
invariants.high_grid_actual_anchor: mandatory first high-stage actual H3 evaluation
invariants.history_reset: fresh sampler/Spectrum lifetime across the geometry boundary
invariants.run_storage: off for matched validation unless persistence itself is the test
